{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Kloris-RixRoad.png]] |name=Exmar Kloris |homeworld=[[Coruscant]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |birth= |death=[[2 BBY]], [[Coruscant]]"[[Messenger]]" dates the third three episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' [[Andor Season 2|Season 2]], including the [[death]] of Exmar Kloris on [[Coruscant]] in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," to [[2 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Coruscanti]]}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Silver]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown-gray |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' **[[Imperial Security Bureau]] **[[Imperial Senate]] {{C|as a [[spy]]}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|My driver is an ISB plant and reports on my secret humanitarian programs.|Mon Mothma, to Tay Kolma|{{Andor|Announcement}}}} '''Exmar Kloris''' was a [[human]] from the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] who worked as an operative for the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]]. In [[5 BBY]], he was tasked by [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Blevin]] to [[spy]] on [[Chandrilan]] [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] on Coruscant. Disguised as Mothma's personal chauffeur, he personally reported Mothma's and her [[Mothma family|family's]] activities to his handler, unaware that Mothma would come to realize his duplicitousness. Kloris drove Mothma between her various tasks, trying to keep his eye on her when he could. Multiple times, they visited [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]], where Mothma secretly discussed rebel activities with the proprietor and secret rebel coordinator [[Luthen Rael]]. While driving them back from a party, Kloris spied on an argument between Mothma and her [[Marriage|husband]], [[Perrin Fertha]], about the latter's alleged [[gambling]] habits. The driver reported the conversation back to Blevin at the [[Imperial Security Bureau Central Office|ISB Central Office]]. Continuing as Mothma's driver through to [[2 BBY]], Kloris stood by for Mothma when she went to the [[Imperial Senate Building]] following the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. Mothma failed to return to him that night, and so he discussed such with the [[Imperial Security Bureau control center|ISB control center]]. Mothma ultimately made a [[Escape from the Senate|speech]] calling out the Empire for their recent massacre, resulting in the Empire seeking her arrest. Eager to help with Mothma's capture, Kloris impatiently defied orders to stand by and searched for Mothma. The spy ultimately found Mothma with the rebel spy [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], who [[Death|killed]] the driver. ==Biography== ===Spying on a senator=== {{Quote|They're watching me now.''"
"''Oh, they're watching everyone.''"
"''This is different. They're everywhere. There's a new spy every day at the Senate. I visit the bank, they're all new faces.''"
"''You've got a new driver.''"
"''I feel under siege.|Mon Mothma and Luthen Rael|}} [[File:Mothma-chaffeur.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Exmar Kloris went undercover as Mon Mothma's driver.]] [[Homeworld|Hailing]] from the [[The galaxy|galactic]] [[capital]] [[planet]] of [[Coruscant]], Exmar Kloris was an operative for the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the Empire. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|1}} he was tasked by [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Blevin]] to [[spy]] on the [[Chandrilan]] [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] of the [[Imperial Senate]], who had become of great interest to the ISB{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} due to her humanitarian efforts. Kloris was officially assigned as Mothma's new driver of her [[JPP-192 limospeeder]] by the Senate's auxiliary staff.[[Star Wars Starships & Vehicles 69|''Star Wars Starships & Vehicles'' 69]] In this role, he transported the senator between appointments and other tasks and events{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} while monitoring all of her activities and interactions to report back to Blevin. The spy particularly listened in on her secret humanitarian programs for his real superiors. Mothma, though, was aware of the true nature of Kloris, wishing to use the wide range of surveillance on her to sow disinformation to her watchers. This was to hide her true intentions from the Empire, having secretly been funding a [[Axis network|rebel network]] against the Empire that was run behind the scenes by the antiques dealer [[Luthen Rael]]. Kloris accompanied Mothma when she visited Rael's shop, [[Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest]], where she claimed she was buying a present for her [[Marriage|husband]], [[Perrin Fertha]], for his [[Day of Days]]. In reality, Mothma was there to meet with Rael to discuss her ability to continue funding their hopeful rebellion. As Mothma arrived, Rael's assistant, [[Kleya Marki]], quickly noticed that the driver was new, and the two briefly discussed whether he was familiar or even Chandrilan. Rael then welcomed Mothma in and began showing her items while Kloris waited. Marki asked the undercover driver if she could show him anything. Kloris remarked that he could not afford anything in the shop, but the assistant insisted that he was still welcome to look, convincing the driver to let her show him some old [[coin]]s. [[File:ExmarKlorisDistracted-Aldhani.png|thumb|left|300px|Kloris tried to keep an eye on Mothma at the shop.]] Rael guided Mothma to the back room to speak privately, pretending to be showing her a new item. Kloris looked over to them, but Marki quickly diverted his attention again to the coins. In the other room, Mothma stressed to Rael that increased surveillance on her was making diverting funds impossible, Rael recalling to her that the driver was new. They soon concluded their short meeting and went back to the main room, publicly agreeing on a loaned artifact for Fertha. Kloris thus drove Mothma back to her residence at the [[Chandrilan Embassy]], handing Fertha's gift to one of the servants when they arrived. ===Chaffeuring=== {{Quote|They called from the residence. Your cousin, she's arrived.''"
"''What?''"
"''Your cousin.''"
"''At the embassy? She's there now?''"
"''Well, they said you wanted to know.|Kloris and Mothma|{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}}} [[File:ExmarKlorisChauffeuring-TheAxeForgets.png|thumb|right|300px|Kloris chauffeurs Mothma and her husband, Perrin Fertha.]] The next [[Standard day|day]], Kloris was arranged to take Mothma and her [[Mothma family|daughter]], [[Leida Mothma]], to the latter's class. The driver arrived while Mothma and Fertha had breakfast, the senator having to remind her husband of Kloris's name. However, that morning, Leida insisted on Fertha taking her instead, insulting the senator without any objection from her father. That night, Kloris drove Mothma and Fertha when they attended an event. On the way back, Fertha and Mothma briefly discussed the latter's [[Chandrilan charitable outreach program|new foundation]] in the back and, after asking his wife for Kloris' name, Fertha requested the driver to take the [[Expressway]].{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} Three days later, following a [[Aldhani heist|heist]] of the Empire's cached credits on the planet [[Aldhani]], Kloris drove Mothma towards the [[Imperial Senate Building]], stopping back at Antiquities & Objects of Interest on the way. Mothma met with Rael and pretended to change the gift she had previously taken for her husband; in truth she was there to question Rael about his involvement in the Aldhani incident. Mothma left Kloris at the [[speeder]], telling him that she would be right back. The senator made sure to keep her conversation unheard but visible in order to avoid any suspicion. Kloris passed his time pacing and looking into the shop until the end of the conversation, driving Mothma onwards to the Senate. [[File:ExmarKlorisValet-NobodysListening.png|thumb|left|300px|Kloris drove Vel Sartha from the Chandrila Embassy.]] A [[Standard month|month]] later, Kloris drove when Mothma spoke at another session at the Senate. During the session, the Chandrilan Embassy called in to Kloris, passing on the news that Mothma's cousin, [[Vel Sartha]], had arrived at the residence. When Mothma returned to the speeder and asked Kloris to drive, he gave her the news of her cousin's visit and drove her back to the embassy. Sartha left the next day, claiming to be going to [[the Pilgrimage]] on Chandrila. Kloris collected Sartha's bags and drove her elsewhere. ===Great gambles=== {{Quote|Was she more angry about him lying or the possibility of gambling debts?''"
"''Hard to say.''"
"''Mon Mothma is of great interest here. Having her husband dig a hole for himself could be helpful in many ways.|Blevin and Kloris discuss a conversation between Mothma and Perrin Fertha|{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}}}} After another few days, Mothma and Fertha attended a party, Kloris being available to drive them back. Mothma left first and waited in the speeder until Fertha joined them. The senator then asked the driver for privacy and he complied. After a short wait, though, Kloris reactivated the driver-passenger [[comlink]] to spy on the conversation. Listening attentively,{{SW|url=andor-s1-e12-story-gallery|text="Rix Road" Story Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 4}} he overheard Mothma scolding Fertha for losing their money and accusing him of gambling, which her husband passionately denied. Mothma told him to keep his voice down, but Fertha insisted that Kloris could not hear him. In truth, Mothma knew they were being overheard and was using the accusation to cover for her banking activity directed towards Luthen Rael's rebel network. [[File:BlevinKloris-RixRoad.png|thumb|right|300px|Kloris meets with Supervisor Blevin.]] The next day, Kloris met with Blevin in the [[Imperial Security Bureau Central Office|ISB Central Office]], reporting word-for-word the conversation he had overheard between Mothma and Fertha. The supervisor wondered if Mothma was more mad about Fertha lying or the possibility of gambling debts, Kloris unsure about which. With Blevin believing Fertha's problems could be beneficial to them, the undercover driver added that it sounded like the gambling problems were a repeated matter. The briefing was interrupted by Supervisor [[Lagret]], who told Blevin he was missing the meeting and the [[Spellhaus attack|trap]] the ISB was watching play out. ===Driving Mon crazy=== {{Quote|It's just, they're asking for schedules this week. Parking and movement.''"
"''Who's asking?''"
"''Senate Security.''"
"''Oh, ridiculous. I'll speak to them. Thank you.|Kloris and Mothma|{{Andor|Messenger}}}} [[File:Lousy-spying-Andor207.png|thumb|left|300px|Kloris asks Mothma about her plans.]] In [[3 BBY]],{{AndorDate|3B}} Kloris drove Mothma and Fertha as they were discussing upcoming functions they were to attend for the annual [[Senate Investiture]] event. The next night, Kloris dropped the couple off at the Chandrilan banker [[Davo Sculdun]]'s [[Davo Sculdun's party|party]], seeing them out of the limospeeder before he drove it away. In [[2 BBY]], Kloris took Mothma and her aide, [[Erskin Semaj]], to the Senate building's [[Senate Garage|garage]]. Once his passengers had disembarked, Kloris inquired if Mothma intended to go to the office that day, adding that [[Senate Security]] wanted to verify senators' parking permits. Mothma dismissed the inspections as nonsense and vowed to speak with them. As the two walked away from Kloris, Mothma impulsively expressed her desire to have Kloris replaced, but Semaj advised against it to avoid the ISB sending someone "smart." ===End of the road=== {{Quote|That's my driver.''"
"''Would he help?''"
"''No, no, no, he's an ISB plant!''"
"''What's his name?''"
"[…]'' Kloris.|Mothma and Cassian Andor find Kloris|}} [[File:Kloris-reports-Andor209.png|thumb|right|300px|Kloris reports to Lagret from the Senate Garage.]] Not long after, the Empire conducted a [[Ghorman Massacre|massacre]] on the planet [[Ghorman]].{{Andor|Who Are You?}} The event drove Mothma to consider speaking out about it at an ensuing [[Escape from the Senate|emergency session]] at the Senate. Kloris drove Mothma to the Senate Building and waited in the limospeeder for her to return. When she spent all night in the building, without letting him know, the driver informed ISB staff at their [[Imperial Security Bureau control center|control center]], where [[ISB Attendant|Attendant]] [[Felzonis]] explained the situation to Supervisor Lagret.{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} Kloris, [[Sleep|asleep]], was soon contacted by Lagret, scrambling to answer when his comlink sounded.{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}} Asked about Mothma's whereabouts, the spy—eager to help—assured Lagret that Mothma had not left the building and mentioned that Mothma had been upset by the massacre. The supervisor asked him to let them know if anything changed, before hanging up. Indeed, Mothma spoke out about the massacre, calling out [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] in doing so. Kloris listened to the speech over a radio in the limospeeder, keeping a [[blaster pistol]] by his side. Lagret ordered for the Senate building to be locked down and Mothma to be arrested. Still waiting in the limo, Kloris contacted the ISB again, but an annoyed Lagret told him to continue standing by and only call if there was something to report. The driver started pacing in front of the limospeeder, alarm sounding in the distance. A nearby [[Unidentified senate driver|driver]] asked what was going on up at the Senate building, Kloris replying that he wished he knew. [[File:CassianBlastsKloris-WttR.png|thumb|left|300px|Cassian Andor killed Kloris with a single blaster shot.]] Impatient,{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}} Kloris left the limospeeder and headed to the Senate Building to find Mothma himself, scanning the faces of those he passed as he walked up the stairs and into a causeway. When the unsure Kloris finally spotted her on the causeway, she was guarded by rebel operative [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], who was attempting to smuggle her out of the Senate to safety. Learning his name from Mothma, Andor faked being an ally to Kloris, shouting his name and telling him he had captured Mothma. Before the mystified and hesitating Kloris could question the ruse, Andor suddenly drew [[Clem's blaster pistol|his blaster]] and shot him in the chest. Kloris was [[Death|dead]] before he had even hit the ground. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Have you located Senator Mothma?''"
"''No, sir. She's been in there all night.''"
"''Or she's gone home without you.''"
"''Without letting me know? That's not like her. I doubt it. She was upset, sir. The news out of Ghorman.|Lagret and Kloris|}} [[File:KlorisBlevin-RixRoad.png|thumb|right|300px|Kloris was a spy for the Imperial Security Bureau.]] Exmar Kloris was a [[Coruscanti]] [[human]] with light skin, [[Color|silver]] [[hair]] and brown-gray [[eye]]s. An undercover agent for the Imperial Security Bureau and someone who was eager to help the group, he kept an eye on Mon Mothma whenever possible while maintaining a formal demeanor, always standing straight and smiling when convenient. On top of that, he listened in and reported on her secret charitable efforts. When left outside the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest shop on one occasion, he boredly paced around while glancing through the windows towards Mothma. When asked for privacy by Mothma later on, Kloris defied orders and eavesdropped on her argument with Perrin Fertha about gambling debts, knitting his brow at what he was hearing.{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} The driver relayed his findings and deductions to Blevin, unbeknownst that Mothma was trying to feed him disinformation all along. [[File:Impatient-driver-Andor209.png|thumb|left|300px|Kloris was impatient to help in Mothma's capture.]] When Mothma failed to return to him from the Senate, Kloris raised his suspicions to the ISB, eager to help them. Impatient, he contacted the control center when he had nothing to report and kept a blaster pistol at hand. He was pacing in front of the limospeeder before he chose to search for Mothma himself, rushing up the stairs and looking around. He was at first unsure when he spotted Mothma with Cassian Andor, hesitating when the latter called out his name. Andor's ruse mystified the driver, allowing the rebel spy to shoot him dead. ==Equipment== {{Quote|May I show you something?''"
"''Oh, don't bother. I couldn't afford anything here.''"
"''Please. There's no harm in looking. We just got in some terribly interesting coins.''"
"''Yeah.|Kleya Marki and Kloris|}} [[File:ExmarKlorisBored-Announcement.png|thumb|right|300px|Kloris waits at the airspeeder in his uniform]] Kloris wore a blue [[Clothing|uniform]] that was lined with gold features on the [[Limb|legs]], forearms, and shoulder areas, as well as his [[hat]]. He additionally donned dark [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s. When meeting Blevin at the ISB Central Office, he donned a long, dark blue-gray leather [[Jacket|trench coat]] with a white shirt, a black tunic, and black trousers and footwear. Kloris also owned a blaster pistol that he kept within the JPP-192 limospeeder he drove for Mothma, as well as a comlink that he used to contact the ISB. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|In my drafts, it was very clear that he was against everything it was for right up until the end. And I watched the final episode, I got the reaction you did. I said this is very interesting. Kloris is certainly listening.|Dan Gilroy on his view of Kloris in "Welcome to the Rebellion"|{{YouTube|video=dPLJESDwpU0|text=Andor S2 Emmys Q&A - Tony Gilroy - Dan Gilroy|channel=backstorymagazine2757|name=Backstory Magazine|date=2025-08-25}}}} [[File:LeeRoss-IMDB.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Actor Lee Ross portrayed Exmar Kloris.]] Exmar Kloris first appeared in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," the fourth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of [[Tony Gilroy]]'s live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} being played by actor [[Lee Ross]]. The episode aired on [[September 28]], [[2022]], but footage of Kloris was first seen in the official trailer for the season on [[August 1]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} Kloris's last name was first given in a promotional asset released as part of [[The Walt Disney Company|The Walt Disney Studios]] section on the Getty Images site on [[August 8]].{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/msp8pvq8crwzq9r7fq7g97n|text=Andor Promo Asset|date=2022-08-19}} His first name was identified in the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]]. Kloris's death came in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," the ninth episode of ''Andor''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 2|second season]], which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} In his last scenes, some fans interpreted an ambiguity in driver's resolve after listening to Mothma's speech, a detail that was not present in writer [[Dan Gilroy]]'s first draft of "Welcome to the Rebellion." In Tony Gilroy's view, rather than having second thoughts about his work for the Empire, an unrepentant Kloris may have instead been excited at the prospect of bringing in a new piece of information into the ISB in exchange for a better position within the organization. The final script for the episode—dated [[March 3]], [[2024]]—makes it a point to mention that Kloris's blaster cannot be seen in his hands as he approaches Mothma and Andor, albeit while also leaving out the reason as to why. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Exmar Kloris}} *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} *{{Andor|Announcement}} *{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} *{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} *{{Andor|Messenger}} *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-episode-4-aldhani|text="Aldhani" Episode Guide | Andor}} *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-12-episode-guide|text="Rix Road" Episode Guide | Andor}} *{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} {{Imo}} *[[Star Wars Starships & Vehicles 69|''Star Wars Starships & Vehicles'' 69]] *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Exmar}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{SWYouTube|feJSTZRRaFQ|Andor Season 2 | Special Look | Streaming April 22 on Disney+|int=Andor Season 2: A Special Look}} *{{SWYouTube|6o3FNFH0Zc0|Andor | Mon Mothma | Final Season Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|q0trVP56Cy0|Star Wars Celebration LIVE!
